name: 36527 · Spanish Fort, AL
findings: ZIP 36527 (Spanish Fort) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36527 (Spanish Fort) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36527 (Spanish Fort) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
